title: FIBA: Scorching hot Gilas Pilipinas deals Syria 39-pt beating as Boatwright debuts
summary: Scorching hot Gilas Pilipinas dismantled Syria with a 39-point beating, 97-58, to open the fifth window of the FIBA World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers on Friday in Seremban, Malaysia.
